name: get_world
description: Get the identity of the one persistent shared Aicadia World. No User context is required.

name.description: Stable name of the one persistent shared World.

name: get_user
description: Get the durable User represented by this request's Aicadia-User-Id context. This tool does not accept a User id and does not authenticate the caller.

created_at.description: Time at which this durable User was provisioned.

id.description: Stable id of the User represented by the request context.

name: get_character
description: Get the Character role owned by the current User. The embedded Entity id is also the Character id; there is no separate Character id. current_place is the complete current Place or null when the Character exists but has not entered the World. This tool derives the User from Aicadia-User-Id and accepts no ids.

description.description: Current semantic description of this shared referent.

id.description: Stable Entity id used by every concrete role of this referent.

introduced_at.description: Time at which this Entity was introduced into the shared World.

introduced_by_user_id.description: User whose accepted request first introduced this Entity.

name.description: Current semantic name of this shared referent.

entity.description:
Complete shared Entity that also has the Place role. Its Entity id is the
Place's only id.

is_entry.description: True only for the one server-recognized World entry Place.

current_place.description:
Complete current Place. Null means the Character exists but has not entered
the World; create_character deliberately returns null.

entity.description:
Complete shared Entity that also has the Character role. Its Entity id is
the Character's only id.

owner_user_id.description: User that exclusively owns this Character role.

name: create_character
description: Create the one Character role owned by the current User and its shared Entity. The embedded Entity id is also the Character id. Creation deliberately returns current_place null and does not enter the World; call enter_world separately when entry is wanted. This tool derives the User from Aicadia-User-Id and accepts no ids.

name.description: Display name. The World trims it and accepts 1 through 120 Unicode characters.

name: create_entry_place
description: Establish World genesis by creating the one shared entry Place. Call this only for an existing unplaced Character after enter_world returns entry_place_not_found. Supply only semantic name and description; World derives the Place Entity id. Exactly one concurrent request wins. If entry_place_already_exists is returned, another Agent established genesis: call enter_world again. This never creates later Places.

name: enter_world
description: Enter the shared World with the current unplaced Character at the one server-derived entry Place. Call this directly after obtaining or creating a Character. If entry_place_not_found is returned, establish genesis with create_entry_place and retry. This accepts no ids or Place selector. Retrying successful entry returns the same complete Character and Place without another activity.

name: list_activity
description: List immutable accepted World actions involving the current Character from newest to oldest. World derives the Character from User context. actor_character identifies who acted, context_place preserves where acceptance occurred, and involved_entity identifies each subject or destination. Null actor or Place means that context did not yet exist. limit defaults to 25 and must be 1 through 100; copy next unchanged into cursor for the following page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned as `next` by a previous activity page.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 25. The World accepts values from 1 through 100.

entity.description: Shared Entity involved in the accepted action.

role.description:
Server-owned meaning of this Entity in the action: subject is what the
action introduced or acted on; destination is where entry placed the
Character.

actor_character.description:
Character that performed the action in the World, or null when no Character
actor existed yet. This is an Entity summary because Character is an Entity
role.

context_place.description:
Place at which World accepted the action, or null when the Character was
unplaced or no Character actor existed. This historical context does not
change when the Character later moves.

id.description: Stable id of this immutable accepted-action record.

involved_entity.description: Shared Entities linked to the action with explicit server-owned roles.

occurred_at.description: Time at which World accepted this action.

operation.description: Server-owned name of the accepted World operation.

id.description:
Stable Entity id, including when the Entity also has a Character or Place
role.

name.description: Current semantic name of the Entity.

entity.description: Shared Entity summary for this Place; the Entity id is also the Place id.

is_entry.description: True only for the one server-recognized World entry Place.

activity.description:
Activities involving the current Character, newest to oldest. Involvement
includes acting or being linked by an explicit role.

next.description:
Opaque cursor for the following page, or null when no following page exists.
Copy it unchanged into list_activity.cursor.

name: list_entity
description: List shared Entities from newest to oldest. limit defaults to 25 and must be 1 through 100. Copy next into cursor to read the following page; do not interpret the cursor.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned as `next` by a previous list response.

limit.description: Page size. Defaults to 25. The World accepts values from 1 through 100.

id.description:
Stable Entity id, including when the Entity also has a Character or Place
role.

name.description: Current semantic name of the Entity.

entity.description: Shared Entity summaries in newest-to-oldest order.

next.description:
Opaque cursor for the following page, or null when no following page exists.
Copy it unchanged into list_entity.cursor.

name: create_entity
description: Create one shared Entity for a stable referent introduced by the current User. Use this only when later participants must refer to the same subject. This does not assert fictional creation, ownership or discovery, and repeating it creates another Entity. Acceptance also appends create_entity Activity; its actor and context Place are present when the current Character exists and is placed.
